verdict.rationale: Graphite has no documented export feature, but its lock-in risk looks low. The CLI is fully git-compatible and runs on existing repositories, and a user reports that stacking metadata lives in git refs, so code and stack structure stay in an open, portable format. It also works on top of a GitHub organization via a GitHub App, which suggests PRs live in GitHub rather than only in Graphite. Missing for 10: any documented data-export capability, export of Graphite-specific data (insights, AI review rules and comments, settings) in open formats, and a documented offboarding path.
